items.question: What are Sami Whitcomb's stats?
items.answer: In the 2026 regular season, Sami Whitcomb averaged 5.3 points, 1.7 rebounds, and 2.1 assists in 21 games for the Phoenix Mercury.

items.question: Where has Sami Whitcomb played in the WNBA?
items.answer: Sami Whitcomb has played for the Seattle Storm (2017 to 2020 and 2023 to 2024), New York Liberty (2021 to 2022) and Phoenix Mercury (2025 to present). She won WNBA titles with Seattle in 2018 and 2020.

items.question: How old is Sami Whitcomb?
items.answer: Sami Whitcomb was born July 20, 1988, in Ventura, California.

items.question: Is Sami Whitcomb Australian?
items.answer: Yes. Sami Whitcomb was born in California and became a naturalized Australian citizen on February 1, 2018. She won Olympic bronze with Australia at the 2024 Paris Games, averaging 13.0 points and 5.3 assists in six games.

items.question: What is Sami Whitcomb's career high?
items.answer: Sami Whitcomb's WNBA career high is 36 points, with seven 3-pointers, against Dallas on July 7, 2025.

items.question: How many 3-pointers does Sami Whitcomb have?
items.answer: Entering the 2026 season, Sami Whitcomb had 511 career 3-pointers, 20th in WNBA history. She was tied with Kara Lawson for the most made off the bench (306).

items.question: Did Sami Whitcomb play for the Perth Lynx?
items.answer: Yes. Sami Whitcomb played for the Perth Lynx in 2022. In Australia's WNBL she won the 2025 title and league MVP with the Townsville Fire.

items.question: How tall is Sami Whitcomb?
items.answer: The WNBA lists Sami Whitcomb at 5 feet 10 inches and 149 pounds.

items.question: Where did Sami Whitcomb go to college?
items.answer: Sami Whitcomb played four seasons at the University of Washington, from 2006 to 2010, and made All-Pac-10 as a senior.
